title: AlexNet获胜 (深度学习的大爆发)
title_en: AlexNet Wins ImageNet (The Big Bang of Deep Learning)

summary.text: 2012年9月30日，在计算机视觉领域的“奥林匹克”——ImageNet大规模视觉识别挑战赛（ILSVRC）上，一个名为“SuperVision”的团队震惊了世界。这个由Geoffrey Hinton和他的两名学生（Alex Krizhevsky和Ilya Sutskever）组成的团队，使用了一个深度卷积神经网络（后来被称为AlexNet），将图像识别的错误率从之前的最好水平26%一举降低到了15.3%。这一断崖式的领先优势彻底击溃了当时主流的“手工特征+SVM”方法。这一刻被公认为AI历史上的“奇点”：它证明了深度学习在海量数据（ImageNet）和强大算力（GPU）的加持下，能解决以前被认为不可能解决的感知问题。
summary.text_en: On September 30, 2012, at the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC)—the 'Olympics' of computer vision—a team named 'SuperVision' shocked the world. The team, consisting of Geoffrey Hinton and his two students (Alex Krizhevsky and Ilya Sutskever), used a deep convolutional neural network (later known as AlexNet) to slash the image recognition error rate from the previous best of 26% down to 15.3%. This massive lead completely crushed the then-mainstream 'manual features + SVM' approach. This moment is widely recognized as the 'Singularity' in AI history: it proved that deep learning, fueled by massive data (ImageNet) and powerful compute (GPUs), could solve perception problems previously thought impossible.
key_points: 错误率从26%降至15.3%，遥遥领先第二名
使用了ReLU激活函数，解决了深层网络的梯度消失问题
引入Dropout技术，有效防止了过拟合
使用了两块NVIDIA GTX 580显卡进行并行训练
标志着计算机视觉从手工特征时代进入深度学习时代
key_points_en: Reduced error rate from 26% to 15.3%, far ahead of the runner-up
Used ReLU activation function, solving the vanishing gradient problem in deep networks
Introduced Dropout technique to effectively prevent overfitting
Trained on two NVIDIA GTX 580 GPUs in parallel
Marked the transition of computer vision from manual features to the deep learning era

story.text: AlexNet的胜利在当时充满了戏剧性。在2012年之前，计算机视觉学术界由数学家把持，他们嘲笑神经网络是“陈旧的黑盒”。Alex Krizhevsky在多伦多大学的卧室里，用两块游戏显卡（GTX 580，因为显存太小不得不把模型切开放在两块卡上跑）训练了这个庞大的网络。Ilya Sutskever后来回忆说，当他们看到结果时，自己都不敢相信。比赛结果公布当天，斯坦福的李飞飞（ImageNet的创建者）激动地宣布了这一历史性突破。紧接着，Google、微软等巨头展开了疯狂的竞标战，最终Google以4400万美元收购了这三人的初创公司DNNresearch——尽管这家公司没有任何产品，只有三个大脑。
story.text_en: The victory of AlexNet was dramatic. Before 2012, the computer vision academy was dominated by mathematicians who mocked neural networks as 'obsolete black boxes'. Alex Krizhevsky trained this massive network in his bedroom at the University of Toronto using two gaming GPUs (GTX 580s; he had to split the model across two cards because the VRAM was too small). Ilya Sutskever later recalled they couldn't believe the results themselves. On the day results were announced, Fei-Fei Li (creator of ImageNet) excitedly proclaimed the historic breakthrough. Immediately after, a bidding war erupted among giants like Google and Microsoft. Google eventually acquired their startup, DNNresearch, for $44 million—even though the company had no product, just three brains.

fun_facts.text: AlexNet是在两块NVIDIA GTX 580显卡上训练出来的。这两块显卡当时主要被游戏玩家用来玩《孤岛危机》（Crysis）。Alex Krizhevsky因为买不起专业卡，只能用这两块便宜的游戏卡凑合，这意外开启了AI使用消费级GPU的传统。
fun_facts.text_en: AlexNet was trained on two NVIDIA GTX 580 GPUs. At the time, these cards were mainly used by gamers to play Crysis. Alex Krizhevsky couldn't afford professional cards, so he made do with these cheap gaming cards, accidentally starting the tradition of using consumer GPUs for AI.

fun_facts.text: AlexNet引入了一个叫ReLU（线性整流单元）的简单函数。以前大家觉得激活函数必须是弯曲的（像Sigmoid），Alex发现把负数直接变成0的直线反而训练得最快。这个简单的改动让训练速度提升了6倍。
fun_facts.text_en: AlexNet introduced a simple function called ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit). Before, people thought activation functions had to be curved (like Sigmoid). Alex found that a straight line turning negatives to zero actually trained fastest. This simple tweak sped up training by 6 times.

simple_explanation.text:
以前识别猫，程序员要写代码：“找尖耳朵，找胡须”。这种方法一遇到猫把头转过去就失效了。
AlexNet的方法是：把100万张各种姿势的猫的照片扔进一个巨大的数学绞肉机（神经网络），让它自己去总结什么是猫。
结果证明，暴力美学（大数据+大算力）战胜了精巧的人工规则。
simple_explanation.text_en:
Before, to recognize a cat, programmers wrote code: 'Find pointed ears, find whiskers.' This failed if the cat turned its head.
AlexNet's approach: throw 1 million photos of cats in all poses into a giant mathematical meat grinder (neural network) and let it figure out what a cat is.
It turned out that brute force aesthetics (Big Data + Big Compute) beat clever manual rules.

applications.title: 谷歌相册 (Google Photos)
applications.text: Google收购这三人的团队后，迅速将技术应用到相册搜索中。这是人类第一次可以搜“海滩”或“拥抱”就能立刻找到对应的照片。
applications.text_en: After acquiring the team, Google quickly applied the tech to Photos search. For the first time, humans could search 'beach' or 'hug' and instantly find relevant photos.

applications.title: DeepDream
applications.text: 后来Google工程师反向运行AlexNet，让它把看到的特征画出来，产生了一种迷幻的、充满狗头和眼睛的奇异艺术风格，这是生成式AI的早期萌芽。
applications.text_en: Later, Google engineers ran AlexNet in reverse, asking it to draw the features it saw, creating a psychedelic art style full of dog heads and eyes—an early sprout of Generative AI.

impact.text: AlexNet是“深度学习革命”的开端。它终结了长达几十年的AI寒冬，让“人工智能”从科幻小说变成了华尔街最热门的投资主题。它的成功直接导致了Facebook成立FAIR实验室，DeepMind的崛起，以及OpenAI的诞生。今天所有的大模型（包括ChatGPT），从某种意义上说，都是AlexNet的直系后代。
impact.text_en: AlexNet was the start of the 'Deep Learning Revolution'. It ended decades of AI Winter, turning 'Artificial Intelligence' from science fiction into Wall Street's hottest investment. Its success directly led to the founding of Facebook's FAIR lab, the rise of DeepMind, and the birth of OpenAI. Today, all Large Models (including ChatGPT) are, in a sense, direct descendants of AlexNet.

influenced_by.contribution: LeNet（AlexNet的架构基本上是LeNet的放大版，证明了卷积网络在规模化后的威力）
influenced_by.contribution_en: LeNet (AlexNet's architecture is basically a scaled-up LeNet, proving the power of CNNs at scale)

influenced_by.contribution: ImageNet（没有李飞飞建立的这个包含1400万张标注图片的数据集，AlexNet就不可能训练出来）
influenced_by.contribution_en: ImageNet (Without this dataset of 14 million labeled images built by Fei-Fei Li, AlexNet could never have been trained)

influenced_by.contribution: GPU（CUDA平台提供了必要的算力，让原本需要几年的训练时间缩短到了5-6天）
influenced_by.contribution_en: GPU (The CUDA platform provided necessary compute, shrinking training time from years to 5-6 days)

influenced.contribution: AlphaGo（Ilya Sutskever后来参与了AlphaGo的研究，深度学习成为了解决复杂决策问题的通用工具）
influenced.contribution_en: AlphaGo (Ilya Sutskever later contributed to AlphaGo; deep learning became the general tool for complex decision making)

influenced.contribution: Transformer（虽然架构不同，但Transformer继承了AlexNet“堆叠层数+大数据+大算力”的成功哲学）
influenced.contribution_en: Transformer (Though architecturally different, Transformers inherited AlexNet's successful philosophy of 'stacking layers + Big Data + Big Compute')

influence_chain.legacy_text: 它终结了寒冬，开启了盛夏。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: It ended the winter and started the summer.

quiz.question: AlexNet在2012年取得成功的三大要素通常被认为是什么？
quiz.question_en: What are commonly considered the three key factors for AlexNet's success in 2012?
options: 更好的摄像头、更快的网速、更聪明的程序员
大数据 (ImageNet)、大算力 (GPU)、深度算法 (CNN)
政府资助、媒体炒作、专利保护
量子计算机、脑机接口、生物芯片
options_en: Better cameras, faster internet, smarter programmers
Big Data (ImageNet), Big Compute (GPU), Deep Algorithms (CNN)
Government funding, media hype, patent protection
quiz.explanation: 这是深度学习爆发的“铁三角”。ImageNet提供了燃料（数据），GPU提供了引擎（算力），CNN提供了图纸（算法）。缺一不可。
quiz.explanation_en: This is the 'Iron Triangle' of the Deep Learning explosion. ImageNet provided the fuel (data), GPU provided the engine (compute), and CNN provided the blueprint (algorithm). None could be missing.
